## What it is

Airalo sells prepaid eSIM data plans for United States. You buy a plan on Airalo's website or app and install it as an eSIM on your phone, alongside your usual SIM. Airalo's feed listed 30 local plans for United States on 13 November 2026.

## How the plans work

The validity period starts when the eSIM connects to a mobile network in its coverage area. If you install the eSIM outside of the coverage area, you can connect to a network when you arrive. Every plan can be topped up. Airalo lists no ID verification (eKYC) for these plans. Plan type: Data or Data, Calls, and Texts.

## Where this page comes from
